Senate (Class 2, plus Florida and Ohio specials)
•  Alabama (open): Barry Moore. Trump-endorsed; won the runoff. Tommy Tuberville left the seat to run for governor.
•  Alaska: Dan Sullivan, incumbent. Trump-endorsed.
•  Arkansas: Tom Cotton, incumbent. Trump-endorsed.
•  Colorado: Mark Baisley. No Trump endorsement on the tracker.
•  Delaware: Michael Katz. No Trump endorsement on the tracker.
•  Florida (special): Ashley Moody, incumbent. Trump-endorsed for the general.
•  Georgia: Mike Collins. Trump-endorsed; won the runoff over the Kemp-aligned candidate.
•  Idaho: Jim Risch, incumbent. Trump-endorsed.
•  Illinois (open): Don Tracy, former state party chair. Not the hard-MAGA lane.
•  Iowa (open): Ashley Hinson. Trump-endorsed.
•  Kansas: Roger Marshall, incumbent. Trump-endorsed.
•  Kentucky (open): Andy Barr. Trump-endorsed.
•  Louisiana: Julia Letlow. Trump-endorsed; won the runoff. Incumbent Bill Cassidy lost renomination.
•  Maine: Susan Collins, incumbent. Trump endorsed her for the general. She is not a MAGA candidate.
•  Massachusetts: John Deaton.
•  Michigan (open): Mike Rogers. Trump-endorsed for the general.
•  Minnesota (open): Michele Tafoya. Royce White ran and lost the primary.
•  Mississippi: Cindy Hyde-Smith, incumbent. Trump-endorsed.
•  Montana (open): Kurt Alme. Trump-endorsed. Steve Daines is not on the ballot.
•  Nebraska: Pete Ricketts, incumbent. Trump-endorsed.
•  New Hampshire (open): John E. Sununu. Trump-endorsed in the primary. He is not a movement MAGA candidate.
•  New Jersey: No Trump-endorsed MAGA nominee on the tracker.
•  New Mexico: No Trump-endorsed MAGA nominee on the tracker.
•  North Carolina (open): Michael Whatley, former RNC chair. Trump-endorsed.
•  Ohio (special): Jon Husted, incumbent. Trump-endorsed.
•  Oklahoma (open): Kevin Hern. Trump-endorsed. Markwayne Mullin is not on the primary ballot.
•  Oregon: No Trump-endorsed MAGA nominee on the tracker.
•  Rhode Island: No Trump-endorsed MAGA nominee on the tracker.
•  South Carolina (open after Lindsey Graham’s death): Darline Graham, his sister, appointed then nominated. Trump-endorsed; won the runoff.
•  South Dakota: Mike Rounds, incumbent. Trump-endorsed.
•  Tennessee: Bill Hagerty, incumbent. Trump-endorsed.
•  Texas: Ken Paxton. Trump-endorsed; beat incumbent John Cornyn in the primary/runoff. Clearest MAGA primary win of the cycle.
•  Virginia: Bert Mizusawa.
•  West Virginia: Shelley Moore Capito, incumbent. Trump-endorsed.
•  Wyoming (open): Harriet Hageman. Trump-endorsed. Cynthia Lummis is not on the ballot.
